text: John Steinbeck's The Grapes of Wrath was banned from schools and libraries by the Kern County Board of Supervisors in August 1939, which cited profanity, obscene language and its portrayal of local people. A December 1939 ALA Bulletin item reported that a number of libraries had banned the book and that the Executive Board had appointed Forrest Spaulding of Des Moines to chair a censorship committee that would report on censorship and formulate a policy statement.
